finding: For every robustly Hurwitz independent closed monic septic box, normalize any common numerator by b6=1. The full set of such numerators is open convex, and its projection to (b0,b2,b4) is open convex. Its complete three-even-root pole set is the inverse Vieta image of that convex set and, whenever nonempty, is open and contractible, with an explicit homotopy given by coefficientwise interpolation. The entire three-gap pole domain is exactly an open bounded polyhedron in Vieta coordinates via six sign inequalities at globally separated odd-root bands. Further, for a fixed box, existence of an unrestricted common numerator is exactly one convex strict LMI system: four compactified degree-7 pairing polynomials, eight 4x4 positive-definite Gram matrices, and b6=1. Rational boxes with a solution admit rational numerator/Gram certificates. This convexifies the whole pole search without restricting the numerator profile, but does not establish that the region is nonempty for every eligible box.
